title: Human approval record
description: Output of stage 11_approval. A human decides publish_report / promote_version / export_orders; the record is bound to artifact hashes so any later artifact change re-opens the gate. The canonical writer is aicwf.controller.approval.write_approval_artifact.

action.description: Consequential action the approval covers (config/gates.yaml approval.actions).

decided_at_utc.description: Wall-clock decision time. This is run metadata, never part of a numeric artifact.

scope.description: Gate scope: 'run' or 'action' according to controller.approval.APPROVAL_SCOPES, or an explicit list of artifacts/actions.

artifact_hashes.description: sha256 of each approved artifact; the gate is bound to these hashes.

version.description: Optional candidate version the approval covers.
